title: Japanese Royal Babka Tempura
description: A unique fusion of Ukrainian babka dough and Japanese tempura, this dish features a light and airy interior with a crispy exterior.
instructions: Prepare the babka dough according to the package instructions.
Dredge the potato pieces in the flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured potatoes in the beaten egg, then coat in the cubed babka dough.
Fry the tempura in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Drain the tempura on paper towels.
Sprinkle with floral salt to taste.
